_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: THE SCANNED EVENT SURVIVES SIGN-IN. A visitor who scans the QR at an event, is told they need an account and signs in is brought back to that event BY THE PRODUCT, instead of landing on the app's home with the event lost and having to find the QR again. A validated goal id is stored and the route is rebuilt from it — never a stored URL — so nothing here can become an open redirect, and nothing stored grants anything. The handoff is one-shot: both signed-in outcomes spend it, guarded by screen focus so the backgrounded event route cannot spend it mid-flow. Also carries the Community Home hierarchy and truthful goal actions from #361. Frontend only.
